needs_atom.missing: A maximum-blockers restriction: 'This creature can't be blocked by more than one creature' (CR 509.1b-c, a blocking restriction on the number of creatures blocking this attacker, at most 1). DeclareBlockersEvent has filter/subject/blocked axes but no blocker-count axis, PREVENT_EFFECT over it can only forbid a block outright ('can't be blocked', Tome Anima), and the executor's block declaration (executor/__init__.py _declare_blockers, completable()) knows only MENACE's minimum of two. Nothing expresses 'at most one blocker'; a whole-block prevention would be stronger than printed.
